title.value: Answer questions from uploaded documents and school emails

introduction.value: In an Amazon demo, Alexa+ answers questions from an uploaded recipe or HOA document and summarizes forwarded school emails into the calendar.

method.value: At Amazon's Devices & Services event, Mara Segal, director of Alexa, demonstrated sharing documents with Alexa+ so it could recall details from them. She asked how much oil was in grandma's zucchini bread recipe, which had been uploaded earlier. The article also says users can upload HOA guidelines and ask questions, or forward several school emails for Alexa+ to summarize and help manage the calendar.

outcome.value: In the demo, Alexa+ pulled the oil amount from the uploaded recipe. The article gives no testing results, accuracy figures or timing, and the HOA and email examples are described rather than shown.

notes.value: This is a stage demo, not a hands-on test, so the article gives no information on cost, availability, or how reliable it is on long or messy documents.

source_text.body:
Answer questions from uploaded documents and school emails
In an Amazon demo, Alexa+ answers questions from an uploaded recipe or HOA document and summarizes forwarded school emails into the calendar.
Done with
A+
Alexa+
What they did
At Amazon's Devices & Services event, Mara Segal, director of Alexa, demonstrated sharing documents with Alexa+ so it could recall details from them. She asked how much oil was in grandma's zucchini bread recipe, which had been uploaded earlier. The article also says users can upload HOA guidelines and ask questions, or forward several school emails for Alexa+ to summarize and help manage the calendar.
How it went
In the demo, Alexa+ pulled the oil amount from the uploaded recipe. The article gives no testing results, accuracy figures or timing, and the HOA and email examples are described rather than shown.
Worth knowing
This is a stage demo, not a hands-on test, so the article gives no information on cost, availability, or how reliable it is on long or messy documents.
Try it yourself
with
Alexa+
Copy prompt
I'm uploading [a recipe, HOA document, or school email]. Answer this question from it: [your question]. If it's a school email, summarize it and propose calendar entries for any dates, and show me them before adding anything to my calendar.
Original source: https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/26/alexa-can-read-summarize-and-recall-lengthy-documents/
source_text.scope: Captured case text; external linked articles and HTML excluded.

translation.body:
根据上传的文档和学校邮件回答问题
在亚马逊的一次演示中，Alexa+ 根据上传的食谱或业主协会文档回答问题，并将转发来的学校邮件汇总到日历中。
实际使用
Alexa+
他们做了什么
在亚马逊的设备与服务活动上，Alexa 业务总监 Mara Segal 演示了将文档分享给 Alexa+，让它能够回忆其中的细节。她问，之前上传的奶奶的西葫芦面包食谱中用了多少油。文章还说，用户可以上传业主协会的规定并提问，也可以转发几封学校邮件，让 Alexa+ 汇总并协助管理日历。
结果如何
在演示中，Alexa+ 从上传的食谱中找出了用油量。文章没有提供测试结果、准确率数字或耗时；业主协会文档和邮件的例子只是作了描述，并未展示。
需要知道的事
这是一次舞台演示，并非上手测试，因此文章没有提供费用、可用性或处理冗长、杂乱文档时可靠性的信息。
自己试试
推荐工具
Alexa+
复制提示词
我正在上传[一份食谱、业主协会文档或学校邮件]。请根据它回答这个问题：[你的问题]。如果是学校邮件，请作摘要，并针对其中的任何日期拟定日历条目；在向我的日历添加任何内容之前，先向我展示这些条目。
原始来源：https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/26/alexa-can-read-summarize-and-recall-lengthy-documents/
translation.scope: 完整逐段翻译既有案例页的标题、简介、工具、方法、结果、限制、全量推荐提示词和原始链接；只省略装饰性头像字样A+。保留2025舞台演示与无测试数字的历史证据边界，不把当前功能、价格、独立评测或我们的分析加入译文；不是外链文章全文翻译。
